nom: NUXE Aquabella Refining Essence-Lotion - Moisturizing Toner for Combination Skin with Natural Ingredients, 6.7 Fl Oz

avis.texte: I have been looking for this timer online for very long time by far the best one I use. Its light doesn’t have strong scent so it’s gentle on my skin and it cleans my pores. It’s a big part of my daily skin routine

Was looking forward to using this but the bottle was not sealed at all! There was no foil seal on the bottle between the product and the lid. Nor was there any sealing/packaging around the lid or bottle. Completely open and exposed! Anything could be in this bottle so definitely not putting on my face. I have requested a replacement so I’ll see if it comes in sealed and I’ll update the review.

avis.titre: Tonico perfetto per chi ha la pelle molto unta!
avis.texte: Personalmente utilizzo questo tonico specialmente quando ho molto sebo altrimenti secca troppo e tende a disidratare, ma quando si ha la pelle molto grassa è perfetto e aiuta a disinfiammare i brufoletti e a seccarli! Ha un profumo gradevolissimo 😍
Estoy muy contenta con el producto que es la segunda vez que compro. Deja la piel limpia, fresca además de hidratada. Cómodo de usar
